course.title: Engineering Economy
course.department: Department of Industrial Engineering and Management

content.value: In a manufacturer company, over a 5 years period, the costs associated with one product line were as follows: first cost of Tk 25,000 and annual cost of Tk 18,000. Annual revenue was Tk 27,000. What rate of return did the company make on this product?

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2016
